patthana20.9:1.1: na saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.9:2.1: na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana20.9:3.1: na saraṇañca na araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana20.9:4.1: hetuyā pañca ārammaṇe dve avigate pañca.
patthana20.9:5.1: na saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā:. na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo dhammo uppajjati nahetupaccayā:.
patthana20.9:6.1: nahetuyā dve naārammaṇe tīṇi novigate tīṇi.
patthana20.9:8.1: na saraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana20.9:9.1: na araṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: na araṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo: na araṇo dhammo saraṇassa ca araṇassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo:.
patthana20.9:10.1: na saraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: na saraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana20.9:11.1: na araṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: na araṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana20.9:12.1: hetuyā cattāri ārammaṇe cattāri avigate satta.
patthana20.9:13.1: na saraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo: .. upanissayapaccayena paccayo: .. purejātapaccayena paccayo:.
patthana20.9:14.1: nahetuyā satta naārammaṇe satta novigate cattāri.
patthana20.9:15.1: yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccanīyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccanīyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ. paccanīyānulomadukapaṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. paccanīyānuloma dukattikapaṭṭhānaṃ nahetuduka nakusalattike hetuduka kusalattikaṃ
